title: eragrostis verticillata var. indica
intro: Eragrostis verticillata var. indica, commonly known as Indian Cup Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Eragrostis verticillata var. indica include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
